bazzite.notes: Dedicated Bazzite/Fedora Atomic target build -> targets/bazzite/ (leaves dev dist/ & Desktop ELF untouched).

fedora_nobara.notes: Compiles on Fedora 43 floor for seamless compatibility on Fedora 43-45 & Nobara + dnf/grubby + kernel-devel.

ubuntu_24_04.notes: Compiles native probe & Qt6 bundle against glibc 2.39 & Linux 6.8 UAPI; includes Snap/GRUB/kernelstub/AppArmor support.

ubuntu_22_04.notes: Uses PySide6 6.7.3 + glibc 2.35 + Linux 5.15 UAPI headers so binary runs natively on both 5.15 GA & 6.8 HWE kernels.

debian.notes: Compiled against Debian 12 Bookworm glibc 2.36 & Linux 6.1 UAPI so the ELF runs on both Bookworm and Trixie.

arch_cachyos.notes: Includes GCC & Clang/LLVM=1 detection, dynamic CachyOS/zen/lts kernel header mapping, AUR & systemd-boot/GRUB/Limine.

steamos.notes: Built against glibc 2.36 + Linux 6.1 UAPI floor for Valve Holo & Neptune compatibility + /run/media MicroSD & steamos-readonly checks.
